title: Prioritize precision@1 for long-tail locales: selection & upgrade plan for reranker suites
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Problem: Some long-tail locales (e.g., th, vi, ro, hu) show degraded precision@1 after recent embedding+rerank upstream changes. Our hosted rerank endpoint must maintain P@1 across all supported locales while keeping tail latency within the 150ms token budget for the cross-encoder stage. This ticket scopes a selection framework and staged upgrade path for cross-encoder variants (full FP16, int8 quantized, distilled compact models) with locale-aware gating and explicit regression checks. Goals: define candidate matrix, run large-scale synthetic + live A/B evals, build smoke/regression harness tied to CI, and implement a safe rollout plan with automatic rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate matrix populated with at least 5 cross-encoder variants covering: original baseline, FP16-optimized, int8-quantized (post-training quant), distilled-small, and gated-hybrid ensemble

Offline eval: per-locale P@1 delta relative to baseline measured on stratified real-query holdout set (≥2k queries per locale), with thresholds: no locale regressions > 1.5% absolute drop and macro P@1 drop < 0.5%
Latency: 95th percentile rerank-stage latency for production-like load must be <= 150ms for 90% of locales in candidate set
Regression harness integrated into CI so that any PR modifying rerank model selection fails if it causes P@1 degradation above thresholds
Rollout plan documented and tested on a canary cohort covering at least 3 long-tail locales before global promotion
perf_targets: Target P@1 improvement: +0.5% macro for long-tail locales compared to current baseline
Latency SLO: P95 <= 150ms at typical load (baseline traffic profile) for rerank stage
Throughput: candidate selection cannot reduce throughput by more than 20% at peak traffic
approach: Phase 0: Build candidate matrix and synthetic evaluation harness (offline ranking metrics + per-locale stratification)
Phase 1: Run stress bench on staging cluster with KV cache warmstart and dynamic batching to measure P95 latency per candidate
Phase 2: Canary A/B with 5% traffic slice for targeted long-tail locales; collect P@1, MRR, latency, and false-positive metrics
Phase 3: Gradual rollout with automatic rollback if any locale crosses regression thresholds or latency SLO breaches for >10 minutes
benchmarks_and_initial_results: Baseline (crossenc-v1 FP16): macro P@1 (long-tail set) = 0.612; P95 latency = 138ms
Candidate: crossenc-int8-opt (post-train quant) = macro P@1 0.604 (-0.8% abs), P95 = 120ms
Candidate: crossenc-distilled-small = macro P@1 0.598 (-1.4% abs), P95 = 98ms
Candidate: gated-hybrid (first-stage bi-encoder shortlist + compact cross-encoder rerank) = macro P@1 0.609 (-0.3% abs), P95 = 110ms
Note: int8 candidate reduces cost per token by ~36% on our T4-equivalent baseline but shows small P@1 drop for vi and th (0.9-1.6% abs)
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Quantized int8 offers strong cost/latency benefits but shows locale-specific regressions; we'll use gating so that int8 is applied only where offline calibration shows no significant quality loss
Distilled-small is useful as a low-latency fallback for burst capacity but not for primary upgrade due to >1% P@1 drop in several inflection locales
Gated-hybrid balances cost and quality by qualifying queries via a lightweight quality estimator; initial estimator prototype lives in PR #3120
We will not pursue kernel-level changes for this ticket; those are tracked separately under ENG-12877
rollout_plan: Canary 1 (target locales: vi, th, ro): 5% traffic for 72 hours; monitor P@1, MRR, latency P95, error rates
Canary 2 (add hu, bg): expand to 15% traffic for 48 hours if Canary 1 passes
Progressive ramp: 15% -> 40% -> 100% over 7 days if metrics stable
Rollback triggers: any locale P@1 drop >1.5% absolute for >10 minutes OR P95 latency breach for >15 minutes OR error rate increase >2x baseline
Post-mortem: if rollback occurs, immediate investigation ticket with root-cause and re-proposal within 3 working days
tests: Offline synthetic evals using stratified holdout (script: tools/rerank/eval/locale_stratified_eval.sh) against dataset 'rerank-holdout-2026-02'
Smoke suite in CI: run top-1 retrieval/accuracy checks for 30 representative queries per locale
Live A/B telemetry dashboard: metabase dashboard 'Rerank Locale A/B' (https://metabase.redwood.ai/d/77/rerank-locale-ab)
Automated regression job: nightly batch that computes P@1 deltas and posts summary to #rerank-alerts Slack channel with gating labels
